errors.evidence: The description states the mmsd series ends at about 80.1% at J=11. However, the data point on the chart for J=11 is clearly lower than the points at J=1, J=3, J=5, and J=7, which are all at or above 80.0%. The point at J=11 is visually at the same level as the one at J=7, which the description also lists as 80.1%. Looking closer, the point at J=11 is distinctly lower than the one at J=7. Therefore, stating it is at 80.1% is incorrect; it is closer to 80.0% or slightly below.
